subject: store: update client-go and pd client (#60164)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. It bumps `github.com/tikv/client-go/v2` and `github.com/tikv/pd/client`, updates TiDB to (1) pass `oracles.ValidateReadTSForTidbSnapshot{}` via context when validating `tidb_snapshot` read TS so validation still happens under the newer client-go oracle behavior, and (2) adapt PD member iteration to the new `GetMembersResponse` return type. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor/store behavior.
